name: @hopsettle/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Hopsettle (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && pnpm run bundle:yaml && pnpm run bundle:json
scripts.bundle:yaml: redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle channels --output src/.bundled/channels.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle accounting --output src/.bundled/accounting.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle pricing --output src/.bundled/pricing.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle staking --output src/.bundled/staking.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle settlement --output src/.bundled/settlement.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle reporting --output src/.bundled/reporting.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle disputes --output src/.bundled/disputes.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle topology --output src/.bundled/topology.openapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:json: redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle channels --output src/.bundled/channels.json && redocly bundle accounting --output src/.bundled/accounting.json && redocly bundle pricing --output src/.bundled/pricing.json && redocly bundle staking --output src/.bundled/staking.json && redocly bundle settlement --output src/.bundled/settlement.json && redocly bundle reporting --output src/.bundled/reporting.json && redocly bundle disputes --output src/.bundled/disputes.json && redocly bundle topology --output src/.bundled/topology.json
